go_no_go_recommendation: Proceed with Caution. The project is highly ambitious and carries significant regulatory and safety risks. It is not an 'Execute Immediately' scenario because the insurance and FAA compliance hurdles are substantial and could lead to total project failure if not addressed before capital expenditure. It is not a 'Do Not Execute' scenario because the 'Pragmatic Foundation' path provides a clear, scalable, and technically feasible framework. To proceed, the team must prioritize the insurance feasibility study and RF site survey before committing the $450,000 seed capital, as these are the two factors most likely to render the project non-viable.
combined_summary: The three most critical actions are: 1) Securing specialty insurance underwriting to ensure the project is legally and financially viable; 2) Conducting a professional RF site survey to prevent signal-related collisions and safety incidents; and 3) Installing hardware-level kill switches to provide a fail-safe against autonomous system errors. These actions address the highest-severity risks—legal shutdown, catastrophic injury, and operational failure—which are the primary bottlenecks to the project's 9-month launch timeline.

feedback.title: Conduct Professional RF Site Survey
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Perform a comprehensive radio frequency (RF) spectrum analysis at your target site by 2026-06-01 09:00 to identify interference from local cellular and industrial sources. Deploy a dedicated CBRS or private 5G network infrastructure instead of standard Wi-Fi to ensure sub-20ms latency for drone telemetry. This is required because urban RF noise is a primary cause of signal drops and mid-air collisions, which would otherwise lead to catastrophic hardware failure.

feedback.title: Procure Initial Drone Fleet and Spares
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Procure 20 industrial-grade, carbon-fiber autonomous drone platforms and an additional 4 units (20% buffer) for immediate parts cannibalization by 2026-07-15 17:00. Establish a local inventory of at least 40 spare propellers, 20 motor assemblies, and 10 flight controllers. This is required to mitigate supply chain lead times and ensure the 50% reduction in downtime necessary to maintain the high-throughput operational model.

feedback.title: Construct Modular Urban-Mimicry Arena
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Erect at least 15 modular, non-combustible urban-mimicry obstacles (e.g., shipping containers or reinforced scaffolding) within a 50-meter by 50-meter grid by 2026-08-01 12:00. Install 5-meter high safety netting around the entire perimeter to contain errant units. This is required to provide the physical environment necessary for semi-autonomous 'follow-me' algorithm testing while preventing drones from exiting the designated flight zone.

feedback.title: Implement Haptic Feedback Integration
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Integrate 20 wearable haptic vests with the central server via a low-latency LAN by 2026-08-15 10:00. Calibrate the vibration intensity to trigger within 50ms of a proximity sensor alert. This is required to provide the sensory immersion that differentiates the HVT experience from standard gaming, directly impacting the 60% repeat-booking target.

feedback.title: Secure Specialty Insurance Underwriting
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Engage a specialty insurance broker to secure a liability policy specifically covering autonomous drone-human interaction by 2026-05-15 14:00. If premiums exceed 15% of projected revenue, immediately pivot to 'soft-drone' technology (foam chassis) to reduce risk profile. This is required because standard recreational policies exclude high-risk autonomous flight, and failure to secure this will result in immediate project insolvency.

feedback.title: Establish FAA and FSDO Compliance
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Submit a formal operational safety case to the local Flight Standards District Office (FSDO) by 2026-06-01 16:00, including documentation of Remote ID implementation and hard-coded geofencing parameters. This is required to prevent FAA-mandated fleet grounding and potential legal fines that would halt operations within the first 3 months.

feedback.title: Install Hardware-Level Safety Failsafes
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Install independent, hardware-level kill switches on all 20 drones that trigger an immediate motor cut-off if the unit exceeds a 2-meter proximity threshold to a player by 2026-07-01 11:00. This is required to provide a redundant safety layer that operates independently of the primary AI software, preventing injury in the event of a software-level collision avoidance failure.

feedback.title: Execute Community Noise Mitigation Plan
feedback.description: To initiate this project, you must: Install low-noise, multi-blade propellers on all units and conduct a decibel-level test at the site perimeter by 2026-07-10 09:00 to ensure compliance with local ordinances. This is required to prevent community backlash and potential zoning challenges that could force a site relocation, which would destroy the project's 18-month break-even timeline.
